# CapCut 9.5.0 (macOS) saved draft

A draft written by `capcut_make_short` on 2026-10-03, opened, played and saved by real
CapCut 9.5.0 (International, macOS 26.6.2, arm64). CapCut created `Timelines/<id>/` and
rewrote media paths as `##_draftpath_placeholder_<uuid>_##/assets/...`.

Trimmed to keep it small: the subtitles track is removed (video, title and music remain).
Sanitized: `device_id`, `hard_disk_id`, `mac_address` are zeros; the home folder is `/Users/USER`.
The test copies `draft_info.json` to the four places CapCut keeps it
(root + `template-2.tmp`, and `Timelines/<id>/` for both).
